scope: Real IAB browser on final candidate source at port 4207; functional lifecycle checks only, concurrent npm check means fixture timing output is not accepted as performance evidence.

checks.covers: unchanged capped scale preserves paused pixels and playing clock; changed scale/refresh repaints; unmount releases clock/observer/capture
actual GPU pixels, transparent alpha, dimensions, camera/renderer/shadow preservation, failure restoration
readback/canvas/shadow pooling, detached snapshots, zero static shadow redraws, dispose
structure/process readiness, initial/silent views, fit-relative resize, pose restoration, capture release and null notification
zero hidden DOM work; timeline/lang/resize/font changes; exact fresh visible recovery; export with labels
